title: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management: policy tuning analysis for priority content-only policies
summary: The briefing's rollout dates, Analytics prerequisite, licensing and policy-tuning behaviour are supported by Microsoft's notice and documentation. The control paths reach the correct pages but could be more complete by naming the Analytics switch and the policy's user-scope selection.

claims.where: summary; What's changing; rationale: risk and impact
claims.claim: Policy tuning analysis gives admins a real-time prediction of how many tenant users could match policy conditions.
claims.quote: Policy tuning analysis provides admins with a real-time prediction of the number of users in a tenant that could potentially match a given set of policy conditions.

claims.claim: This update extends policy tuning analysis to policies scoped for priority content.
claims.quote: With this update, policy tuning analysis will support insider risk policies that are scoped for priority content.

claims.claim: The priority-content scoring option scopes scoring and alerts to specified activities involving priority content, subject to the cumulative-exfiltration exception stated in Risk assessment.
claims.quote: Risk scores are assigned and alerts are generated only when specified activities include priority content. Activities without priority content aren't scored, but you can still review them if an alert is generated.

claims.where: front matter: defaultState; summary; Why it matters; Scope; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Using this capability requires an administrator to enable Analytics, supporting admin-opt-in.
claims.quote: This change will be available by default for admins to configure. To use this feature, admins will need to enable Analytics in Insider risk management > Settings.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.model; licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: The capability is an option within licensed Insider Risk Management, supporting the included licensing model.
claims.quote: | Insider Risk Management | Included |

claims.claim: Microsoft Learn documents no PowerShell or Graph operation to change the Analytics setting at the time of writing.
claims.quote: Searched: site:learn.microsoft.com/powershell insider risk analytics; Set-InsiderRiskManagementPolicy Analytics; Microsoft Graph insider risk analytics setting. Read Analytics, Get started, and Defender IRM Graph integration excerpts; none documented this switch.

claims.claim: Microsoft Learn documents no PowerShell or Graph operation to change the priority-content scoring option at the time of writing.
claims.quote: Searched: Insider Risk Management Analytics enable PowerShell Graph priority content scoring Set-InsiderRiskManagementPolicy; InsiderRisk PowerShell priority; site:learn.microsoft.com/graph insider risk priority content. Read policies and Get started; no setting operation found.

claims.claim: The Analytics control is reached through Microsoft Purview portal > Settings > Insider Risk Management > Insider risk settings > Analytics.
claims.quote: Select Settings in the upper-right corner of the page. ... Select Insider Risk Management ... Under Insider risk settings, select Analytics, and then turn off the setting.
claims.fix: Extend controls[0].ui.path and its rendered copy to 'Settings > Insider Risk Management > Insider risk settings > Analytics > Scan your tenant's user activity to identify potential insider risks'. The switch label is documented at https://learn.microsoft.com/purview/insider-risk-management-configure#step-3-optional-enable-and-view-insider-risk-analytics-insights, already cited.

claims.claim: The printed policy-wizard path reaches the priority-content scoring option in the Microsoft Purview portal.
claims.quote: On the Policy template page, choose a policy category and then select the template for the new policy. ... Scoring: ... Choose Get alerts for all activity or Get alerts only for activity that includes priority content.
claims.fix: Use 'Insider Risk Management > Policies > Create policy > Policy template > policy category > template > Users and groups > Include all users and groups > Content to prioritize > I want to prioritize content > Scoring > Get alerts only for activity that includes priority content' in controls[1].ui.path and its rendered copy. The omitted user-scope selection is documented at https://learn.microsoft.com/purview/insider-risk-management-configure.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Data exposure
claims.claim: The gauge estimates scoped users whose activity in the previous 10 days exceeded the lowest daily thresholds for selected built-in indicators.
claims.quote: The gauge shows the approximate number of scoped users whose activities from the previous 10 days exceeded the lowest daily thresholds for at least one of the selected built-in indicators for the policy.

claims.claim: The experience includes a top-five indicator list ordered by users exceeding the lowest daily thresholds.
claims.quote: The top five indicators list is sorted by the number of users exceeding the lowest daily thresholds.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Data exposure
claims.claim: Per-indicator insights show approximate numbers of users whose previous 10 days of activity exceeded the indicator's low thresholds.
claims.quote: The insight shows the approximate number of users whose activities from the previous 10 days exceeded the specified low thresholds for the indicator.

claims.claim: Learn's real-time analytics section does not mention priority-content policies, so the feature-specific workflow rests on the notice.
claims.quote: Searched: Insider Risk Management real-time analytics priority content policy thresholds analytics licensing. Opened Configure policy indicators; read Use real-time analytics recommendations through Prerequisites. That section describes general analytics, not priority-content policies.

claims.claim: Real-time threshold insights help policy authors assess thresholds before activating policies.
claims.quote: This feature helps you configure the appropriate thresholds for each indicator to achieve the highest level of alert effectiveness before activating your policies.

claims.claim: Manually adjusting an indicator threshold updates its insight in real time.
claims.quote: If you select the Choose your own thresholds option and manually adjust a threshold setting for a specific indicator, the insight for the indicator updates in real time.
